description: Client-side implementation of ITimelineDataProvider that filters, orders newest-first, and windows an in-memory list of timeline entries. Useful for opting into the provider-based filtering/pagination pipeline for TmTimeline, TmActivityTimeline, and TmActivityLog without wiring up a server, or as a test double.

members.name: GetEntriesAsync
members.description: Applies the query's text/type/internal filters, orders the matches newest-first, and returns the requested Skip/Take window together with the total matching count.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter and paging options for the requested slice.

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Token used to cancel the operation.
